purpose: Compact repository localization map for ToolScout agents. Consult this before broad repository traversal.
localization_rule: Open the smallest relevant subsystem set first. Broaden only when the map or direct imports do not resolve the task.

public_site.notes: Tool profiles, comparisons, navigation hubs, news/editorial surfaces, canonical public rendering and outbound policy.

finder_and_publisher_kit.notes: First-party Finder API and publisher embed assets, including Publisher Kit and embed telemetry boundary.

command_center.notes: Owner-facing analytics and operational truth. GA4, GSC, D1 and outbound ledgers retain separate source-of-truth roles.

growth_planner.notes: Shared Growth Brain, mission cadence, prioritization and external-value-first policy.

distribution.notes: Discovery, qualification, submissions, learning, outreach and network distribution.

seo_aeo_geo.notes: Search execution, GSC truth bridge, public SEO transforms and editorial-authority architecture.

affiliate.notes: Affiliate routing, coverage workflow and owner-ready human actions. Editorial ranking remains affiliate-neutral.

content_and_audience.notes: Software news intelligence, social audience workflows and newsletter capture/HubSpot sync.

catalog.notes: Catalog admission, runtime quality and machine-readable software discovery.

infrastructure.notes: Cloudflare control plane, D1 binding, Render execution plane, crons and production entrypoint.

integrity_and_tests.notes: Run the narrowest relevant checks first, then architecture/preservation gates for cross-cutting changes.
